derived_features.name: complete curated causal drug-target access path
derived_features.definition: A stored Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct relationship exists for a causes-qualified member of the full affects descendant closure with ChEMBL, Guide to Pharmacology, or DrugCentral primary-source support.
inputs: The full pinned affects descendant closure on Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct edges
derived_features.construction: Filter raw edges by causes qualification and any of the three sources, group by canonical endpoint pair, count distinct raw relationship identities, and merge one compact relationship per pair. Missing qualifiers or source arrays do not qualify. The rule uses only presence, then rematches raw edges with its recorded exact predicates, qualifiers, and sources. Removing the initial access-path MATCH and WITH before the marked comment gives the otherwise identical unmaterialized query.
derived_features.formula: compact presence iff count(distinct qualifying raw relationship)>0
derived_features.interpretation: This is a query acceleration, not a prediction threshold or an extra biological condition. Full-closure and exact-filtered target rules both rematch their own raw evidence. No training or held-out treatment labels define the access path.

derived_features.name: distinct downstream gene direction balance
derived_features.definition: Two signed causal activity edges compose to net decrease when their signs differ and to net increase when their signs agree.
inputs: Every qualifying signed drug-regulator-gene path in the stated graph pattern
derived_features.construction: Group all paths by drug and disease. Independently collect distinct canonical downstream gene IDs for opposite-sign and same-sign paths. Ignore null CASE values. A gene with both path signs belongs to both sets, so parallel edges and regulators cannot inflate its vote.
derived_features.formula: L=count(distinct net-decreased genes); H=count(distinct net-increased genes); size(lower_genes)>0 AND size(higher_genes)=0
derived_features.interpretation: At least one disease gene must receive a net-decreasing path and no disease gene may receive a net-increasing path. Sign consistency does not identify whether disease causation reflects gain or loss of normal gene function.

mechanism.rationale: Gene-level direction consistency may distinguish corrective intervention from generic signed network proximity. Association does not establish a corrective clinical mechanism.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[compact:MINER_R0004_CURATED_TARGET]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE compact.artifact_id='r0004-curated-causal-target-v1' WITH DISTINCT chemical,regulator /* END CURATED ACCESS PATH */ MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:{{relationship_types:direct}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE direct.predicate IN {{predicates:direct}} MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}} AND target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ["increased","decreased"] AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[bridge:{{relationship_types:bridge}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE bridge.predicate IN {{predicates:bridge}} AND bridge.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ["increased","decreased"] AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:{{relationship_types:causal}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE causal.predicate IN {{predicates:causal}} AND (regulator<>gene) WITH chemical,disease,collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN target.object_direction_qualifier<>bridge.object_direction_qualifier THEN gene.id END) AS lower_genes,collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN target.object_direction_qualifier=bridge.object_direction_qualifier THEN gene.id END) AS higher_genes WHERE size(lower_genes)>0 AND size(higher_genes)=0 RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,size(lower_genes) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: direct: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; target: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; target: enforce primary-source membership in infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral; bridge: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; The upstream regulator and downstream disease gene must be distinct.; At least one disease gene must receive a net-decreasing path and no disease gene may receive a net-increasing path.

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Source assertions lack dose, exposure, clinical context, and experimental causal validation.
